methods: Exact filename/id re-lookup through Roboflow workspace search to confirm split and original URL
Single-image Roboflow media_analyze, ten successful calls
Read-only saved native Roboflow annotation geometry for all 10 image IDs; all annotation_valid true
Cross-check cosine values with frozen 19-Nov embedding JSON
AI scene descriptions compared after independent calls; no image bytes exported or humans recruited

valid.scene: Close-up portrait of worker in bright yellow hard hat, clear eye protection and white respirator; industrial background blurred.

train.scene: Close-up portrait of worker in yellow hard hat, clear eye protection and white respirator, navy work jacket and lanyard; industrial background blurred.

support: Matching five saved legacy label categories and counts
Distinct AI one-image descriptions agree on prominent hard hat, glasses, white mask and blurred industrial background
pairs.limitation: No side-by-side independent frame alignment or original pixels; cannot label pixel duplicate and do not infer person identity.

valid.scene: Clear side-shield eyewear, straight-on studio view, white background and oval 'Anti-Fog Lens' sticker on viewer's right lens.

train.scene: Clear side-shield eyewear, straight-on studio view, white background and oval 'Anti-Fog Lens' sticker on viewer's right lens.

support: Same distinctive sticker location and lettering in two AI summaries
Similar framing and small differing dimensions
One saved Goggles source box per image
pairs.limitation: Description-based comparison cannot prove same underlying photograph or cropped/resized derivation.

valid.scene: Transparent plastic safety glasses, white studio background, three-quarter perspective.

train.scene: Transparent plastic safety glasses, white studio background, front three-quarter view.

support: Matching dimensions and source label classes
Similar 3/4-view clear safety glasses in white studio descriptions
pairs.limitation: Generic product appearance makes it insufficient to say these are the same photo/source.

valid.scene: White-backdrop stock-style portrait: hard hat, white respirator, orange reflective mesh vest, gloved raised hand touching helmet brim; stock watermarks visible.

train.scene: White-backdrop stock portrait with yellow hard hat, white mask, orange reflective mesh vest and raised gloved right hand at helmet brim; Alamy watermarks/bottom banner described.

support: Distinctive matching pose: glove on helmet brim
Matching orange mesh vest, yellow hard hat, white mask and studio white background
Watermark/stock-photo features in each AI report
Similar but not identical source dimensions and label inventories
pairs.limitation: Watermark brand and stock photo identifier not independently matched; product/individual identity and exact duplicate status not established.

valid.scene: One yellow ABS safety helmet, white background and Thai promotional writing/brand marks.

train.scene: One orange ABS safety helmet, white background and Thai/English marketing text/logos.

support: AI descriptions explicitly distinguish yellow vs orange helmet despite high cosine
Same 300×300 size and single hard-hat label
Common marketing style could explain strong embedding similarity
pairs.limitation: Independent image descriptions do not certify source ownership/capture independence or background template lineage.

interpretation: Two strong candidate shared portraits/products and one stock derivative; one similar eyewear product image candidate; one distinctive color-different hard-hat pair illustrating high cosine nonidentity. None is adjudicated duplicate.
